items:
What You Will Love About Turquoise Turtle Cottage

Turquoise Turtle Cottage welcomes you with relaxed coastal style, spacious comfort, and the luxury of your own private pool. With four bedrooms and three full baths accommodating up to 12 guests, there is room for everyone to gather while still enjoying private retreats. The first-floor living area is bright and open, flowing seamlessly to the patio and pool so indoor and outdoor living feel effortlessly connected. From slow mornings with coffee in the sunshine to relaxed evenings after the beach, the inviting layout keeps everyone comfortably together.

The kitchen blends style and function with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and bar seating that makes meal prep a shared experience. The adjacent dining area is perfect for everything from casual breakfasts to fresh Gulf seafood dinners. A first-floor guest bedroom with a queen bed and twin-over-twin bunks offers flexible sleeping arrangements and direct patio access. A hall bath with a walk-in shower and a convenient laundry room complete this level.

Upstairs, the King Primary suite provides a peaceful escape with private balcony access and an en suite bath featuring a tub/shower combination. Down the hall, the bunk room includes full-over-full bunks and its own tub/shower combo bath, creating a comfortable haven for kids or teens. Soft coastal tones and natural light enhance the welcoming atmosphere throughout. Generous front and back yards framed by palms and native greenery offer additional space to relax, and small dogs are welcome so the whole family can enjoy the getaway.

What You Will Love About Blue Mountain Beach

Blue Mountain Beach is one of the most beloved communities along Scenic 30A, known for its laid-back charm and beautiful, uncrowded shoreline. The sugar-white sand and emerald waters are just a short 3–4 minute walk away with no major roads to cross, making beach days easy and spontaneous.

You are also perfectly positioned to enjoy some of the area’s favorite local spots. Enjoy coastal comfort food at Cowgirl Kitchen or grab fresh juices, organic bites, and specialty groceries at For the Health of It, both conveniently located right here in Blue Mountain Beach. Treat yourself to a sweet scoop at Blue Mountain Beach Creamery or enjoy live music and vibrant flavors at Red Fish Taco, all just minutes away. The peaceful neighborhood setting, surrounded by native greenery and gentle sea breezes, gives you that tucked-away feel while keeping everything within easy reach.

What You Will Love About 30A

Scenic 30A is a collection of charming coastal communities connected by bike paths, rare coastal dune lakes, and stunning Gulf views. Exploring is part of the experience, whether you are cruising along the paved trail, discovering boutique shops, or sampling fresh Gulf seafood at a new favorite spot.

Head east to experience the colorful cottages and lively town centers of Grayton Beach and Seaside, or venture west toward the quieter stretches of Dune Allen and the upscale shopping and dining of Miramar Beach. Each community offers its own unique personality, yet all share the relaxed, coastal elegance that makes 30A such a sought-after destination.

What You Will Love About Ocean Reef

Your stay at Turquoise Turtle Cottage is elevated by the trusted care of Ocean Reef Resorts. With over 40 years of experience along the Emerald Coast, Ocean Reef provides 24/7 guest support to ensure your vacation is seamless from arrival to departure. You will also enjoy exclusive perks, including discounts on golf, tennis, and area rentals, adding even more value to your time along 30A. With attentive service and local expertise, Ocean Reef makes your coastal escape effortless and unforgettable.

First Floor: Living Room with Patio Access, Queen Sleeper Sofa, Kitchen, Dining, Guest Bedroom with Twin Bunk and Queen Bed + Patio Access, Hall Bath with Walk-In Shower, Laundry.

Second Floor: King Primary Bedroom with Tub/Shower Combo and Balcony Access, Bunk Room with Full Bunks and Tub/Shower Combo.

*Note – This property may have date restrictions that apply. All reservations submitted online are a request until receiving an email confirmation from Ocean Reef Resorts. For more details, please review our Minimum Night Stay under Rental Policies. An e-signed rental agreement is required prior to arrival.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
